name: Baked Ranch-Crusted Chicken with Brussels Sprouts & Cauliflower
instructions: Place bread crumbs and spices in a medium bowl. Stir to combine.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and spread out on a large baking sheet pan. Spread ranch dressing over the chicken thighs, coating both sides. Working in batches, dredge chicken in the bread crumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere; return to the baking sheet.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve Brussels sprouts. Transfer to another large baking sheet along with the cauliflower.
Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.

Place both baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring veggies and flipping chicken halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender and chicken is golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide veggies and chicken between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
